name: iracing-coach
description: Produce concise corner-by-corner iRacing Race Cards with damage-aware telemetry, strategy, groove evidence, and NASCAR-first setup tuning.

interface.shortDescription: Concise race cards and NASCAR-first setup tuning
interface.longDescription: Turn recorded iRacing telemetry and read-only setup artifacts into a fast corner-by-corner Race Card, evidence-based tire/fuel strategy, damage/tow/repair-aware run screening, groove-migration analysis, full archived diagnostics, companion-dashboard data, NASCAR-first new-week packages, and controlled one-change open-setup experiments with history and rollback.
defaultPrompt: Give me a concise corner-by-corner Race Card for my latest race.
Build a NASCAR open-setup package for this week's track.
Diagnose my latest race and recommend one setup change.
